pages.title: Goal and sequence
pages.text:
**Goal:** turn basic resources into materials for the next chapter.\
1\. Unravel Frayed Thread into string when you need it. Keep some Thread for trading.\
2\. Follow recipes for Void Yarn, a Binding Knot and a Loomframe.\
3\. Make a Tension Barrel and keep water nearby.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: 4\. Follow Recover for clay, porcelain and the route to handling lava.

pages.title: Test small batches
pages.text: Read the Loomframe and barrel recipes before adding items. Start with one batch and check the output. Keep the input and result in separate storage until you know the process.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Then work towards sieving and better meshes. An iron mesh opens the route to Strand Filament. Follow the active quests and recipes for the exact substrate and mesh combination.\
The next model is a workspace example; adjacent placement alone does not automate these stations.
Example layout, not an exact quest requirement. Read the steps for materials and operation.
